title: Senior Design Quality Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Hinge Health’s Hardware organization and help build safe, reliable, scalable healthcare products that improve how people move beyond pain. As a Sr Design Quality Engineer, you’ll be a core member of cross-functional product development teams, guiding design quality from early concept through commercialization and design transfer.



You’ll bring practical expertise in design controls, risk management, verification and validation, reliability, manufacturability, product development lifecycle activities, and process validation. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, manufacturing, purchasing, test, supplier engineering, and Regulatory Affairs to help teams move quickly without compromising patient safety, product quality, or compliance.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH


IN YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS

 - Build working knowledge of Hinge Health’s quality management system, product development lifecycle, tools, and design-quality practices.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with hardware, software, systems, product, program management, and Regulatory Affairs stakeholders.

 - Join active product development programs and begin reviewing requirements, design records, risk documentation, and development plans for quality and compliance gaps.


IN YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS

 - Own or materially contribute to design-control and risk-management execution across product development programs, from user needs and design inputs through design outputs, verification, validation, and transfer.

 - Help teams create and maintain complete, accurate, traceable, and inspection-ready design history file records.

 - Develop and review risk-based verification and validation strategies, including protocols, reports, acceptance criteria, traceability, and objective evidence.

 - Provide actionable quality feedback on design architectures, component selections, requirements, drawings, interfaces, usability and human-factors considerations, and risk controls.


IN YOUR FIRST YEAR

 - Drive quality readiness for design transfer and commercialization by partnering with manufacturing, purchasing, test, and supplier engineering on scalable designs, process validation, production readiness, and configuration control.

 - Lead or support product risk-management activities covering user, design, process, supplier, and software-enabled product risks, and help teams make balanced decisions that protect patient safety.

 - Support Regulatory Affairs with submissions, responses to regulatory questions, and audit preparation, participation, response development, and follow-up.

 - Coach and influence engineering teams on design quality, design controls, risk management, data analysis, protocol development, reliability, and design-for-quality methods.

 - Identify and implement practical improvements to quality workflows, templates, instructions, and cross-functional ways of working as Hinge Health scales its medical-device product organization.


WHO YOU ARE

 - A quality engineering subject matter expert who can guide cross-functional teams through complex, regulated product development and commercialization activities.

 - A risk-based decision maker who protects patient safety and product quality while thoughtfully balancing schedule, cost, technical, and business constraints.

 - An owner who solves complex problems with minimal oversight, follows issues through to resolution, and escalates risks that could affect safety, compliance, or launch readiness.

 - A clear communicator who can translate complex technical, quality, and regulatory information for engineers, cross-functional partners, and executive stakeholders.

 - A collaborative coach who makes design quality practical and relevant, helping teams adopt strong practices without relying solely on authority or procedure.

 - A Learn-it-all who stays curious about evolving medical-device standards, software-enabled products, reliability methods, and better ways to scale quality.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related technical field.

 - 6+ years of experience in quality engineering or a related field, including at least 4 years in a medical-device design and development environment.

 - 3+ years of experience applying design controls and risk management from early design and development through commercialization, including experience with electromechanical systems and applicable medical-device standards such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR Part 820.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Advanced degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related technical field.

 - Experience with software as a medical device (SaMD) and software in a medical device (SiMD).

 - Experience navigating a quality management system with minimal oversight across individual product development projects.

 - Demonstrated ability to make balanced risk decisions, build consensus, and work through complex technical challenges.

 - Experience coaching, mentoring, or teaching engineering teams in design quality, data analysis, protocol development, reliability, or design-for-quality methods.

 - Experience communicating complex quality, technical, and regulatory information to executive management.


HINGE HEALTH HYBRID MODEL

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office, requiring in-person attendance three days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.


ABOUT HINGE HEALTH

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.



With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences, and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care, from acute injury to chronic pain to post-surgical rehabilitation, through personalized, evidence-based care.



As the preferred partner to 60+ health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,800 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore.



Learn more at hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com.


WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

 - Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

 - Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

title: Senior Software Automation Engineer
description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Lead automation and quality engineering for a X3 squad, turning customer and migration risks into fast, reliable evidence that supports confident releases.

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong automation programming in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages.
- Experience with UI, API, GraphQL, integration, data and end-to-end test design.
- Strong SQL/data validation, REST/SOAP integration and batch or migration workflow testing.
- CI/CD, containers, test data, observability and defect analysis in a cloud-native environment.
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
- Ability to explain quality risk and evidence in clear English across time zones.

Modern platform skills for this role

- Automate contract and event-integration checks, secure pipeline controls, release/upgrade/rollback evidence, and migration reconciliation. Make failures observable and useful to developers; apply container or orchestration test environments when relevant to the suite.

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle or Web/Syracuse testing.
- Working X3 domain knowledge and understanding of metadata, customisation and upgrade risk.
- Contract testing, performance testing, accessibility, security or chaos/resilience testing.
- Migration comparison tooling, synthetic monitoring or golden customer datasets.
- Cloud environments and partner certification.

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years in quality engineering or software automation, with ownership of automation for a substantial product area. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline.

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.

Expected outcomes / success measures

- The squad has a trusted regression signal for the highest-risk customer and migration paths.
- Quality gates run consistently in delivery pipelines and failures are diagnosed promptly.
- Migration and upgrade evidence supports predictable go/no-go, hypercare exit and rollback decisions.
- Manual regression effort and escaped defects reduce without reducing meaningful coverage.

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior/Principal Automation Engineers, Product, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and migration/partner teams across India, Europe and North America.

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Challenges weak evidence respectfully, follows risk to impact and helps the whole squad own quality.

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Design and implement maintainable automated tests across UI, API, GraphQL, data, integration, performance and operational journeys.
- Own risk-based regression for an X3 domain or platform capability, including legacy-modern equivalence and customisation behaviour.
- Integrate tests into CI/CD quality gates and make failures diagnosable, actionable and visible to the squad.
- Support migration waves, upgrades and rollback rehearsals with repeatable evidence and clear exit criteria.
- Coach Software Automation Engineers and partner with developers early in design and implementation.

Decision ownership:

Test design and automation approach for owned scope, risk-based coverage, evidence quality and release recommendations within agreed programme guardrails.

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.
